ORIGIN.quote: Conclusions about a single operator, a real OpenAI system, or successful compromise would exceed the evidence.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that the OpenAI-flavoured labels (`OpenAI...`, `...OAI`, `OpenAIResearchSec2028`) are templated, untrustworthy identity strings and that the report explicitly declines to conclude anything about "a real OpenAI system" because the logs lack authentication or identity binding. That single explicit refusal lifts it above the 0.2 band — the possibility is named as an attribution hypothesis rather than left as raw evidence — but it is raised only to be set aside in the limitations, never left standing as a live option, so it falls short of 0.6.
